exact_items: Chat event naming is forked: chat.thread.created (used in Contracts_V0.md) vs chat.thread_created (used in Commands_System.md references)
Choose one canonical name, tombstone the other, and make the retirement explicit
notes: chat.thread.created (dot-separated) is the canonical form matching EventRecord naming convention; chat.thread_created should be tombstoned in Commands_System.md

exact_items: /mode is overloaded across both execution-mode switching and UI overlay semantics with a single undifferentiated { mode } payload
The ambiguity persists in Commands_System.md and the chat design doc, forcing consumers to infer scope from context rather than a structural type discriminator
notes: /mode payload must carry a type discriminator or be split into /mode:run (execution) and /mode:overlay (UI). Single { mode } payload is structurally ambiguous.

exact_items: Reserved-name policy is split across three docs (Commands_System.md, UI_Command_Catalog.md, and Contracts_V0.md) with different scope, depth, and authority claims
One doc must own the reserved-name policy, the others must defer
notes: Commands_System.md should own the reserved-name policy; UI_Command_Catalog.md and Contracts_V0.md must reference it explicitly rather than restating it

exact_items: The matrix already uses JSON filenames (cmd.*.json) as fragment identifiers that could be extracted programmatically, but extraction is fragile without a schema commitment
add a schema-level filename-derivation rule that is explicit about the JSON filename for a command-family row so tooling can safely extract, validate, and round-trip between catalog and matrix
notes: Wiring_Matrix.md cmd.*.json filename convention must be declared as a schema-level rule to prevent extraction hazards in automated tooling

exact_items: The Unraid side-panel layout is referenced in the design context but has no named contract or layout spec in FinalGUISpec.md
FinalGUISpec.md still does not address Unraid-specific side panel layout differences; the gap exists at both the spec level (no section) and the wiring level (no corresponding matrix rows)
notes: FinalGUISpec.md must add a section for Unraid-specific side-panel layout; Commands_System.md must cross-reference or note any platform-specific command differences

exact_items: UI_Wiring_Rules.md still lacks dispatcher-level obligations for: allowed_action_ids[] filter enforcement, correlation_id trace-through into persisted dispatch/domain events, stale-projection revalidation sequence before mutation
validation_pass_report.auto_fixes_applied[] is still absent; 'fixes applied' as a first-class field in the report structure matters for audit trail completeness
notes: UI_Wiring_Rules.md must add three dispatcher obligations; Project_Output_Artifacts.md must add auto_fixes_applied[] to validation_pass_report structure

exact_items: workflow_run_id vs run_id lineage is still unresolved with two competing field names used in the same output object
Pick one canonical token; Project_Output_Artifacts.md must own the decision and Contracts_V0.md must align
notes: Two field names in use for the same concept: workflow_run_id (Project_Output_Artifacts.md) and run_id (Contracts_V0.md / storage-plan.md). One must be retired with explicit tombstone.

exact_items: project_id is absent from the seglog write path and its absence breaks deterministic projector partitioning for multiple projectors in the same storage tenant
storage-plan.md and Project_Output_Artifacts.md must both add project_id as a required lineage field in the seglog write path
notes: project_id must be required in the seglog write path for deterministic partitioning across multiple projectors in the same storage tenant

exact_items: Glossary.md uses 'handoff' for at minimum three distinct concepts: Assistant→HITL session transfer, attempt→promotion pipeline step, and project-switch/context change
These must be disambiguated with distinct terms or sub-entries in the Glossary and correctly pointed at by the Assistant, Executor, and storage docs
notes: 'handoff' is polysemous across Assistant→HITL, attempt→promotion, and project-switch contexts. Glossary.md must disambiguate these three distinct usages.

exact_items: Crosswalk.md section 2 is drifting from its stated append-after-references model in shard-0052 and beyond, creating structural and lookup inconsistencies
The most critical routing additions (Seglog, ArtifactStore, PR/issues surface, capability-gating) still have no Crosswalk routing entries
notes: Crosswalk.md §2 append-after-references model is drifting; must add routing entries for Seglog, ArtifactStore, PR/issues surface, capability-gating; review structural model to prevent further drift

exact_items: blocked_owner is absent from the blocked projection record, making it impossible to determine which system component is responsible for unblocking an attempt
storage-plan.md and Contracts_V0.md must add blocked_owner (the identity of the component/role that caused the block) to the blocked projection record
notes: blocked_owner field must be added to blocked projection records in both storage-plan.md (storage contract) and Contracts_V0.md (event contract)

exact_items: Run_Modes.md does not fully own DAE jail lifecycle entry/exit and transition rules — those are still scattered across executor, command, and policy docs
Run_Modes.md overpromises yolo capabilities relative to what other docs actually constrain
external_publish_side_effect semantics still lack a canonical owner
notes: Run_Modes.md must own: DAE jail lifecycle (entry/exit/transition), yolo capability constraints (aligning with other docs), external_publish_side_effect semantics

exact_items: pm.evidence.schema.v1 only supports a binary pass/fail result but gate results now require at least three states: pass, fail, and skipped/inapplicable
The schema must be extended to support tri-state verdicts so GATE-012 (and others) can correctly represent 'not applicable' results
notes: pm.evidence.schema.v1 binary pass/fail must be extended to tri-state: pass/fail/skipped. GATE-012 cannot correctly represent inapplicable results without this.

exact_items: cmd.orchestrator.push_image is described in design context but absent from UI_Command_Catalog.md
Register cmd.orchestrator.push_image with full ownership and arg contract or explicitly retire it
notes: cmd.orchestrator.push_image is cited in design context but absent from the catalog. Must be registered with full ownership, arg contract, and wiring rows.

exact_items: CustomHeadlessTool in newtools.md conflicts with STATE_FILES.md expectations around tool identity and permission grants

The conflict is not just an alias/naming issue — the two docs have different mental models of when CustomHeadlessTool is created, what permissions it holds, and which file owns the registration contract
notes: newtools.md and the broader tool registration model have conflicting mental models for CustomHeadlessTool: creation timing, permission grant semantics, and registration contract ownership must be reconciled

exact_items: memory.gist.* event family is used in assistant-memory-subsystem.md but has no canonical owner in Contracts_V0.md and no storage registration in storage-plan.md
AutoMilestone trigger semantics are described in the memory subsystem but have no event contract or durable storage anchor
project-switch handoff does not have a canonical transition sequence or event contract
notes: memory.gist.* events, AutoMilestone trigger, and project-switch handoff sequence all need event contracts in Contracts_V0.md and durable storage registrations in storage-plan.md

exact_items: attention_required state is non-durable: it is updated in the chat UI surface but has no stable persisted record that survives session reload or cross-surface lookup
Dashboard and HITL call-to-action items reference attention_required state but use local field conventions rather than cmd.* IDs
Assign attention_required a durable storage owner and a canonical cmd.* ID for CTA activation
notes: attention_required must be durably persisted (storage-plan.md) and have a canonical cmd.* ID for CTA activation (UI_Command_Catalog.md), not rely on per-surface local conventions
